02 / THE PERSON BEHIND THE PROMPT
A little curiosity.
A lot of tinkering.
Hey, I’m Will. This is the home for my personal projects: tools for local AI, keyboard controls, and the little details that make a Linux desktop feel right.
From a native app to a tiny shell plugin, the idea is the same: make something useful, understand how it works, and put the code out there.
See what I’m building on GitHub ↗
